skill_name: Compare and contrast industrial robots and collaborative robots.
workflow: Industrial robots are typically used for repetitive tasks in hazardous environments and tend to be very expensive to purchase and maintain. They are used in a variety of sectors including automotive, aerospace, manufacturing and electronics and are generally bolted to the floor and separated from people.
